blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The 2026-27 NBA season continued Sunday, October 25 (October 24 in the US), with a packed eight-game slate headlined by the Philadelphia 76ers, San Antonio Spurs and Denver Nuggets. NBA Scores Today: October 25 Philadelphia 76ers beat Milwaukee Bucks, 127-116 Joel Embiid recorded a triple-double with 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists, while Tyrese Maxey scored 26 points and VJ Edgecombe had 17 for Philadelphia.
